t: Created by Britain, France and Russia in 1832 with Otto of Bavaria as king, it was the first nation state carved from the Ottoman Empire.
Pursuing the Great Idea of uniting all Greeks, it more than doubled its territory before defeat in Asia Minor in 1922.
Abolished in 1924, restored in 1935, it lived through occupation, civil war and a military junta that ended the monarchy in 1973.
dyk: King Alexander of Greece died in October 1920 of an infection from a bite by a pet monkey; his death led to the return of his father Constantine I and changed the course of the war in Asia Minor.
ev: Otto of Bavaria lands at Nauplia as first King of Greece
Britain cedes the Ionian Islands as George I begins his reign
The Balkan Wars bring Thessaloniki, Macedonia, Epirus and Crete into Greece
Defeat in Asia Minor; Smyrna burns and over a million refugees flee
The monarchy is abolished; it is restored by plebiscite in 1935
Greece rejects Italy’s ultimatum and drives the invaders into Albania
The colonels’ coup; Constantine II goes into exile after a failed counter-coup
